text:
maria_v: Heads-up: starting observability bring-up for ap-southeast-2 GPU pool (burst nodes). Need checklist for logs/metrics/traces, dashboards for per-node GPU util/mem, KV-cache traces, and alert templates for cost/packet-loss/oom. Target handoff EOD Thu. Who's owning validation?

alex_k: I can lead validation. Can we prioritize: 1) Prometheus scrape + node exporter 2) Loki for logs 3) Tempo for traces 4) Grafana dashboards 5) Alerting. Also need sampling rules for trace span retention.

samir: Noted. Are we picking partitioned Loki (index/gateway) or single? For burst zones we should avoid indexing everything — use label-based index and tailing to reduce cost.

jess: Agree on label-based indexing; set log retention 30d for burst nodes to save cost. I'll add tenant "gpu-burst-ap-southeast-2" to Loki config.

riley: I'll prep terraform modules for observability-stack: prometheus, grafana, loki, tempo, s3 for chunks. Will push initial branch by EOD.

maria_v: Thanks. Basic smoke tests I'd like:
- metric ingestion: prometheus scrape target count >= expected
- logs: ingest a sample log with pod name and verify pipeline parsers + label extraction
- traces: trace through request path including kv-cache hits; verify sampling rules and retention
- dashboard: at least GPU util panel and per-node memory pressure panels
- alerts: page on GPU driver OOM, sustained packet loss >5m, and sudden spike in observability ingestion cost

alex_k: I'll write smoke checklist. Quick alert examples: 
```yaml
groups:
- name: gpu-alerts
  rules:
  - alert: HighGPUUtilization
    expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization_percent[5m]) > 85
    for: 5m
    labels:
      severity: page
    annotations:
      summary: "GPU utilization >85% on {{ $labels.instance }}"
  - alert: GPUDriverOOM
    expr: increase(node_dmesg_gpu_oom_total[1m]) > 0
    for: 1m
    labels:
      severity: page
```
Loki pipeline snippet for tag extraction: 
```yaml
- pipeline_stages:
  - json:
      expressions:
        pod: pod_name
        level: level
  - labels:
      pod: pod
      level: level
```
Tempo sampling example: keep 100% for error traces, 10% for normal, 1% for internal: 
```yaml
receivers:
  jaeger: {}
processors:
  probabilistic_sampling:
    sampling_rate: 0.1
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
    - name: error_traces
      decision_wait: 1s
      policies:
      - type: status
        status_code: error
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan started for feature/obs-gpu-apse2 :gear:

jess: For dashboards, we'll reuse the gpu-cluster-overview and add panels: per-model-inference-latency, kv-cache-hit-rate, tokens_per_sec_per_pod. I'll draft a Grafana JSON model and share.

samir: Trace sampling: keep 100% for error traces, 20% for user-facing requests, 1% for internal worker spans. Also include span tag propagation for kv_cache.hit (boolean) so dashboards can filter.

maria_v: Can we add a cost alert: if projected monthly observability ingestion/storage >20% above baseline then page SRE. Baseline = current account baseline for eu-west and ap-southeast combined. Also add network egress alert for spikes.

riley: I'll add an estimated-cost recording rule that multiplies ingestion_rate * estimated_per_gb and a Prometheus alert for threshold. Also wiring to billing-export metrics.

alex_k: Assigning owners: prometheus/jess, loki/jess, tempo/samir, grafana/riley, validation/alex_k. I'll open a PR with smoke tests + runbook steps.

maria_v: One more: ensure KMS keys for S3 buckets are customer-managed per Private-mode deployments. jess pls confirm key name and ACLs.

jess: Confirmed — bucket kms: redwood-obs-apse2-cmk, encryption enforced, no public ACLs. Will add bucket policy to terraform module.

riley: Branch pushed: feature/obs-gpu-apse2, PR #4821. Running terraform apply now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply complete — resources created: prometheus-apse2, loki-apse2, tempo-apse2, grafana-apse2, s3-redwood-obs-apse2

maria_v: Validation pass? alex?

alex_k: Smoke tests: metrics OK (scrape targets = expected), logs pipeline OK but Loki label extraction missed inference pod id on a couple of pods — small tweak to parser needed; traces: span kv_cache.hit is not yet propagated from model server, will coordinate with runtime team; dashboards mostly OK. Alerts: simulated GPU util alert fired. Cost alert simulation worked (recording rule + alert). Will submit small PR for parser + trace instrumentation changes.

samir: I'll update the model server instrumentation to add span tag kv_cache.hit and bump sampling hook. Plan to ship a minor release to the runtime image with that change.

alex_k: Re-ran smoke tests after parser fix and tempo instrumentation — passes. Marking ready for handoff.

maria_v: :tada: Great work. Handoff checklist completed. Please schedule a 30m walk-through with Platform next Tue 10:00am. Attach runbook link once PRs merged.
